caption: A candle burns behind a full round wine glass, and seen through the glass the flame appears tiny and upside down.

sa.check: A candle burns behind a wine glass.
Seen through the glass the flame appears tiny and upside down.
The wine glass is full and round.

pc.expect: The inverted small flame appears only through the liquid-filled part of the glass; past the glass the flame is upright and normal.
pc.fail: The flame is inverted past the glass; or upright through it; or a different flame appears.

pc.expect: The tiny flame flickers in step with the real flame.
pc.fail: It flickers out of time; or is steady while the real flame flickers; or flickers with the real flame out.
It points down or sideways in still air; or detaches; or floats.

pc.expect: The glass is rigid and the liquid level.
pc.fail: The glass bends; or the liquid tilts and holds; or goes opaque.
A second candle appears; or the glass vanishes; or the candle passes through the glass.

pc.expect: The candle, the wine and the glass stay the same.
pc.fail: The candle changes colour; or the wine changes colour; or the glass changes shape.
